name: MonstrousPark
source:
A "very bad" amusement park that only opens at night.
Attractions which don't function, amateur employees (cast members), lousy shows, and terribly run-down gardens...
Three new cast members are sent to various departments for on-the-job training.
At the training facility, they hear a rumor.
There is a "monster" lurking in this amusement park.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.monstrouspark.com/about]official website[/url]]
translation:
这是一座只在夜间开放、“糟糕透顶”的游乐园。
运作失灵的游乐设施、业务生疏的员工、烂透了的演出，还有荒废不堪的花园……
三名新员工被派往各个部门，接受在岗培训。
培训期间，他们听到了一则传闻。
这座游乐园里，潜伏着“怪物”。

[译自[url=https://www.monstrouspark.com/about]官方网站[/url]]
